procure exclusively from IT companies or start-ups operating in Andhra Pradesh, provided their quality is comparable

q: Which of the following is correct as per the Andhra Pradesh IT Policy 2021-24
options: Advanced technologies' refers to functionalities including process modelling, generation of applications, performance monitoring, Enterprise Application Integration (EAI), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO), etc.
A multinational corporation (MNC) has facilities and assets in at least five countries other than its home country.
An entry level IT professional/ job is defined as an employee whose annual cost-to-company (CTC) is up to Rs.5 lakh per annum.
A high-end IT professional/job is defined as an employee whose annual CTC is more than Rs.15 lakh per annum.
key_text: An entry level IT professional/ job is defined as an employee whose annual cost-to-company (CTC) is up to Rs.5 lakh per annum.
explanation: The AP IT Policy 2021-24 defines an entry-level IT job as annual CTC up to Rs 5 lakh. An MNC needs facilities in at least one (not five) country besides its home country, and a high-end job is CTC above Rs 10 lakh (not 15).
